data.title: Dow Jones Futures: S&P 500, Nasdaq Near Highs; ASML, Nvidia's Chipmaker Taiwan Semi To Kick Off AI Earnings
data.description: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq are currently close to their highs, although experiencing some volatility. The upcoming earnings reports from chipmakers ASML and Nvidia, as well as Taiwan Semiconductor, will play a significant role in determining the direction of the artificial intelligence (AI) stock market pullback. Investors are closely watching these companies as their performances could influence the market's bullish trends. The Dow Jones Futures indicate a positive outlook with potential for growth as the market anticipates the earnings releases.

data.title: Stock Market Today: Dow Pops As Indexes Finish Week In The Black; Big Bank Earnings Up Ahead
data.description: On Friday, the Dow Jones index experienced growth despite a drop in Apple stock during morning trading. SpaceX saw a notable increase following a move related to Starlink. The stock market concluded the week positively, with the indexes finishing in the black. Upcoming big bank earnings are anticipated. This information was reported by Investor's Business Daily.

data.title: Cresco Labs Announces Filing of Supplement to Management Information Circular for Annual General and Special Meeting
data.description: Cresco Labs Inc. disclosed today that they have submitted a supplement to their management information circular from September 18, 2026, related to the upcoming annual general and special meeting on October 30, 2026. The supplement aims to provide improved and clarified information regarding the proposed amendment to Cresco's super-voting shares. Cresco Labs trades on the CSE under the symbol CL, on the OTCQX as CRLBF, and on the FSE as 6CQ. This update signifies the company's commitment to transparency and effective communication with its shareholders.

data.title: Absolute Security Acquires Phoenix Technologies’ FirmGuard to Build on the Firmware Foundation Enterprises Need for Secure, Compliant, and Resilient AI
data.description: A company based in Seattle, Absolute Security, known for its expertise in Autonomous Cyber Resilience, revealed that it has successfully completed the acquisition of Phoenix Technologies’ FirmGuard. The latter specializes in UEFI BIOS firmware security, along with management and networking services. This acquisition will bring new capabilities to Absolute Security's existing technology, known as Absolute Persistence®, which is a patented firmware-embedded solution forming the core of their Autonomous Cyber Resilience Platform. With the addition of FirmGuard, the platform will now offer enhanced features such as increased visibility, integrity verification, posture management, continuous patching, as well as compliance enforcement for endpoints and AI workstations.
